notes.title: Orc Massage DevLog #10
notes.content:
Hello every masseur, thank you for waiting for us and here’s the devlog.
The game Orc Massage is planned to implement the DragonGirl update in the first quarter of 2025.

Besides the progress on the DragonGirl update, we also made some changes to the game’s optimization and content.

This update includes much much more compared to the last Mermaid update, so it has taken longer to complete.

The above is the devlog this time.

The following content are test screen during development,and may be modified later.

[h2]1.The H-animations for DragonGirl are nearing completion.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/0189dbf2c05f3c7545d7d87eeecfe9426b51e0b8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/a4a4378acf5e43e7ab88b6ab8276a6620b532803.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/a9b76ae3cbc99933a8bdc91c0eac8186862ca895.png[/img]
[h2]2.Improvements to the storytelling performance for DragonGirl’s storyline.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/1420dd44aca1c1f2441d94a840b1df09590c7945.jpg[/img]
[h2]3.VIP body part system activated, favorability value removed.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/9cd7914ce241224cc391978935fc029874818dec.png[/img]
[h2]4.The shop system is being changed from purchasing via computer to requiring players to visit stores in person.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/397544d91180919c4a5d5a47c83503b0c8b8fdb5.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/f32f7ae92389134f242f30311cc16fa09c6f6647.png[/img]
[h2]5.Update of massage system and User Interface.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/4cff3c198ec4854c8d0ea6af396dc51eb1701abf.png[/img]
[h2]6.Plans to add an outdoor roaming system where Orc can move around specific small areas.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/24d82f713687c7209ab127f9a37da7c43b88022e.gif[/img]

notes.title: New Update - New VIP Customers [Emma]
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdXl3aDU4N3FjZXc1M2k2OG56cWNqZ2VrZDZjdDFoYjRtYTY0cndmaSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/1zX3Dgq00mXPdTKSUF/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone, Orc Massage has finally finally released the mermaid update. Thank you for your patience![/h1]

[h2]The main updates include the following:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Thalia introduced Emma to the store, remember to buy a water pipe.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/ea25518b1ff1ff422e5d58e420c99d1d4fee842f.png[/img]
[*] The time is running out, featuring day-night cycles time system.
[*] Goblin has developed a better massage course for VIPs.
[*] The computer has desktop now.
[*] Orc's massage techniques will arouse the desires of VIPs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/041b60df122ff364e238be3cb008b164dc0eab34.png[/img]
[*] Griffon Shop has released a massage magazine.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/1af429e70fdd29f6b1729ec6be218a413fd22c34.png[/img]
[/list]

Korean, Russian, and some translations are still being processed, so we are using 
machine translation to assist. We will update the translation as soon as it is officially completed.

[h2]Developer's Message[/h2]
Thank you very much for your support. This update has indeed taken a very long time. During this period, we have made significant adjustments to the game.


We hope that Orc Massage can have a relevant impact on the daily lives of VIPs after their massages. That's why we have added the VIP massage course and designed the comfort level for different body parts of VIPs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/4bc6a68d6993ef1e3a9fa594c638ca6b5fb51e49.png[/img]
We are also planning to develop “community” feature in the future. This will allow players to see small events related to the comfort or discomfort of VIPs in their daily lives.


By dividing the comfort levels of different body parts and adding a visualized “stress”  for characters. It is expected that the upcoming system will give players more options to assist the VIP massage.


About the next character【Dragon Girl】,we are continuously working on her design and development.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/60ceb25fc3237e264dd58acdcb35a323f2eef3f0.png[/img]

[h2]About the devlog/devtalk[/h2]
The devtalk is a monthly message after the game released on steam to provide updates every month to keep everyone informed of the development progress.However, after discussions, we have decided to change it to every two months so that the content will be more rich when we make updates.

[h1]Once again, we sincerely thank you for supporting Orc Massage.[/h1]

notes.title: Jan DevLog
notes.content:
[h3]Progress of Mermaid Story[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/ed5229a2ccde6047e980253ace8b3ca9ea252969.png[/img]

This is presently the last story of Mermaid, from acquaintance to intimacy, will have this story based material wrapped up by the end of the month 

[h3]Modification of DragonGirl’s texture and 3D model[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/286c2b2984fe9f5ce32628ad8e3ee87e2773687d.png[/img]

We took a step back to make sure Dragon Girl is truly ready for implantation once we have Mermaids finished. 

[h2]Program Progress[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/9aee6cb745618967ecb2c2ae501a08cddff6bbbf.png[/img]
[h3]Massage System Updated[/h3]

We are now working on our massage system more and implementing more personalized systems. Now girls will be able to communicate. with the player more on what their wants and needs are. Stay tuned to get a feel how this works once we have everything set to go. 

[h3]New Character Body Parts System[/h3]

Certain parts of the body will be prone to developing issues depending on what type of monster girl your dealing with. It will be up to you to talk to the girls and learn about what their wants and needs are in order to maximize performance.

[h2]Dev Talk[/h2]

In January, some regions in Asia start to take long holidays. Just like Christmas, people return home to spend the holiday with their families. As the majority of Torch Studios team members are from Asia, we vacation, but we are back to continue working diligently on the game! 

2023 is the Year of the Rabbit but there is no rabbit in Orc Massage, but we can still celebrate our glorious Tiger girls in Vietnam! it's year of the cat over there!

This was drawn by Artist [url=https://twitter.com/radiokeg]Deel[/url] who is Valarie's character designer.

Happy New Year to everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/793d5a0c188a621413c8dcea3bf5262d387d6b81.png[/img]

notes.title: July DevLog
notes.content:
[h1]July Dev Talk / Devlog [/h1]

Hello everyone! Here is some progress on Orc Massage in July.

[h2]Ava's Custom-designed Furniture[/h2]

An exclusive set of furniture of Ava from the furniture system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/edbcf8a0d99715c6bcfb4f256875a66c7515b006.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/5bc9b75d4fb406458f9167b8b6a8f2b8e850a034.gif[/img]

[h2]Mermaid Water Test[/h2]

In June, we tested the new fluid effect which can produce the water used in the debut of Mermaid.
Orc Massage’s twitter have presented this scenario in the [url=https://twitter.com/OrcMassage/status/1534444552396087297] Mermaid Manga[/url]and will reproduce this performance in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/58ac7ead77b5ea85129c31a4e9ab08e1c2f33e8c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/d223d632653820c209cd6c4012ffd2e62362479a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/defbdc6d018feb8f43ddcb0a23be9a1a785ce6ce.gif[/img]

[h2]Mermaid H-Animation[/h2]

We finished the general base of Mermaid’s animations in June, we are still working on some small details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/a1a3024cdfe0426e41bf4a30a73f4edde994dbab.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/42a4b9ff98687e1e512c61044d2af41c142538f6.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Game Loop[/h2]

The core game mechanics of favorability and massage will be heavily reworked.
This mechanics update is expected to be available together with the debut of Mermaid.

[h2]About 0.6.3[/h2]

The 0.6.3a version was uploaded in about two days and received some reports of instability issues.
Most of the bugs appeared when we changed the design to optimize the game. We are now temporarily returning the game to the previous version.
The game will update to 0.6.3 after further testing.

notes.title: June Devlog
notes.content:
[h2]Dev Talk / Devlog[/h2]
Hello Steam community, thank you for your support to the early access version.

The dev team have read every message in the forum, but due to staffing and language issues, we are not able to reply to every message.

We will post a devlog every month and make progress reports with Steam players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/5843f8838cd91e51ad54877b394b3cb94ceb2bc7.png[/img]
[h2]There are huge number of animations in Orc Massage and it takes a lot of time to make them.[/h2]
Each of primary female characters in the Orc Massage has a very large amount of animation.
According to the current specs, there are：
1. 7 sets of animations in the house
2. massage animations, each posture also has three states
3. cutscene

Because Mermaid has both human and fish modes that resulting in more animations, please wait patiently for Mermaid.

We are working hard on Mermaid and have hired a new animator to work with us on this project.

[i][b]To be completed game system[/b][/i]

At the same time as the art is progressing, the programing part is also in the process of adding more content, fixing bugs and dealing with performance issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/596cc595620e1d98645475359b4c26d6596b659f.png[/img]
Furniture System
[h2]Mermaid Dev Progress[/h2]

Mermaid Bouncing Test
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/4a95eb1c8e035ba0f618d8797fd2fd655ee0b593.png[/img]

Thank you to those who read through the devlog, and thank you for your support.

notes.title: Update: Orc Massage Version 0.6.2
notes.content:
New build is up! Right now before we continue adding more features we are focused on fixing and adjusting the core experience we have, as well as making sure that it's nice and solid before we continue with more complex mechanics.

Thanks to the excellent feedback we have received we've moved on to fixing some of the reported issues. We still have a lot of work to do, but the new tutorial we provided gives you guys a more comprehensive experience on what we are trying to accomplish and how the game is played. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/76e7ae61e17d7697ab352a9cad297157e6d7a5c0.png[/img]

[list]
[*] No more black screen glitch when switching into Japanese language.
[*] Ava sex scenes no longer cause the body to disappear.
[*] Ava now has her phone! (All the time...)
[*] Ava's position on the sofa has been fixed.
[*] Valerie's handcuffs on the orc no longer disappear.
[*] Valerie will no longer "yeet" herself randomly from the massage table. 
[*] Fixed languages appearing in other language settings.
[*] Fixed interface when money is not enough.
[*] Fixed several incorrect displays of some transitions in-game and in cutscenes.
[*] The names of the characters now appear correctly in the phone list.
[*] As well as miscellaneous fixes you guys helped us spot.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/8345413d51d416a1618228e08ab80541de3280df.png[/img]

[list]

[h3][*] A NEW TUTORIAL HAS BEEN ADDED![/h3]
[*] [i][b]Gallery mode has been added! [/b][/i]You can now revisit previous scenes with the characters once you unlock them. Load into the parlor and call a client, then talk to them to engage in their individual scene menu!
[*] You will be able to change the girls' costumes inside the gallery mode.
[*] You can now adjust the speed of movement in "happy ending" activities.
[*] Multi-camera system is now added to "happy endings".
[*] More Graphic quality settings have been added.
[*] Orc can now be fully transparent in H scenes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/e8d48626116183cf9b19628fb4908dba2c8d6225.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/ee78d457e6ebb5dcb96f2aac8c689b3663973278.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/8a229d7e5534af73499442e4f611f9c5481aea2d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/c23d663b5e33f96a18e4842cb58717bbada9b81e.png[/img]

[h2]Sneak Peaks[/h2]

Mermaid is coming!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/0a2da692fdb325ea91742c813ed155bfc2cd0367.png[/img]

notes.title: Orc Massage Early Access is Released!
notes.content:
Sorry for the slight delay (again...) but ORC MASSAGE IS OUT!

Thank you very much everyone for being patient with us. It's been a tough road for this game and torch studios, but we finally have it in a state where we can show what we've got to all of you!

Of course this is[i][b] an Early Access release so expect to see some "jank"[/b][/i]. However, the charming elements and the basic gameplay loop is here for all of you to enjoy.  

[h2]Here's our basic roadmap![/h2]

We will be going into more detail on what these each of these things mean later, but for now we will be primarily focused on optimizing before moving forward with more content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37538275/c3171c4ee45545da0de56a64888338b5f0c3e7c7.png[/img]

We will actively work on fixing any bugs that you guys report and this game will be a constant flux of updates.

you can post the stuff you find in this thread! 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1129540/discussions/0/3186862752320466283/

Big thanks to all of you for assisting us in this Early Access process in order to get this game to be the best that it can be.  Please report what you guys find so we can get it addressed ASAP!
